title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity + v1.97.0 bump
author: Ava Patel
description: This PR consolidates cross-language SDK changes: 1) unifies auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go to match server-side semantics (token refresh, retryable status mapping, idempotency keys), 2) improves streaming API ergonomics (cancellable streams, backpressure hooks, clearer type signatures), 3) addresses parity gaps reported between language SDKs (stream event shapes, error codes, default timeouts), and 4) bumps SDK versions to v1.97.0 with changelog entries. Motivation: customers migrating between SDKs faced inconsistent retry semantics and streaming surface area, leading to production discrepancies and hard-to-debug reconnect loops. This changeset includes tests and migration notes to keep upgrades low-friction. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth/token refresh across SDKs - [x] Standardize retry policies and default retryable status codes - [x] Add streaming cancellation and explicit close API - [x] Add parity tests for event shapes and error propagation - [x] Version bump and changelogs The description below summarizes the surface-level changes, highlights compatibility notes, and calls out required follow-ups in docs and release communications.
commits: Normalize token refresh flow in Python/TS/Go
Implement cancellable streaming API for all SDKs
Add parity tests for stream events and retry behaviour
Fix edge case: stream reconnect on transient 503
Bump versions to v1.97.0 and update changelogs
review_comments: Diego Morales: Overall looks good, but please ensure the Python token refresh doesn't block the event loop; consider making the refresh call async-friendly.
Ava Patel: Addressed with a non-blocking refresh and added tests that simulate token expiry under load.
Priya Kumar: TS changes are ergonomic but we should expose an explicit CancelToken alias in the top-level export for discoverability.
Ava Patel: Added CancelToken export and updated TS docs.
Ethan Zhao: Go client looks fine; one nit: prefer context.Context used consistently across stream methods.
Ava Patel: Switched stream methods to accept context and added context-related tests.
CI: integration-tests flaky on first run due to a transient infra timeout; reran and all checks passed.
release_notes: v1.97.0: Unified auth/retry semantics across SDKs, improved streaming ergonomics (cancellable streams and backpressure hooks), parity fixes for stream event shapes and error propagation, minor API ergonomics tweaks, bug fixes for transient reconnects. See docs/sdk-migration.md for migration steps.
notes_for_release_team: Notify customers about retry semantics change and streaming cancellation API. Recommend opt-in testing for high-throughput streaming workloads. Docs PR queued to redwood-docs; marketing to prepare upgrade guidance.
